mapper.select: select n.*, m.mname from notice n join member m on n.mno = m.mno order by n.nno desc
select n.*, m.mname from notice n join member m on n.mno = m.mno where n.nno = #{nno}
mapper.insert: insert into notice(nno, ntitle, ncontent, nfiles, ndate, mno) values(NOTICE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{ntitle}, #{ncontent}, #{nfiles, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{mno})
